title: std::vector<T,Allocator>::~vector
summary: A destructor. Destructs the vector. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.
html:
~vector();
 (constexpr since C++20)

A destructor. Destructs the vector. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

Complexity

Linear in the size of the vector.
